name: Guan Chong Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股息派发、股份拆细上市、季度业绩及与SMC Food21 (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd.的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估10%以上，未披露业务板块扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, additional listing of subdivided shares, quarterly results, and recurrent related party transactions with SMC Food21 (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. exceeding estimated values by more than 10%; no business segment expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment was disclosed.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 2026年公告涉及股息派发、股份拆细上市、季度业绩及与SMC Food21的经常性关联交易金额超出预估，未披露具体业务板块动态。
segments.note_en: 2026 announcements covered dividend payments, additional listing of subdivided shares, quarterly results, and recurrent related party transactions with SMC Food21 exceeding estimates;

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述与SMC Food21的经常性关联交易实际金额进一步超出预估金额10%以上。
actions.text_en: The actual value of the aforementioned recurrent related party transactions with SMC Food21 further exceeded the estimated value by more than 10%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Guan Chong Cocoa Manufacturer Sdn. Bhd.与SMC Food21 (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd.的经常性关联交易实际金额超出股东通函所披露的预估金额10%以上。
actions.text_en: The actual value of recurrent related party transactions between wholly-owned subsidiary Guan Chong Cocoa Manufacturer Sdn. Bhd. and SMC Food21 (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. exceeded the estimated value disclosed in the shareholders' circular by more than 10%.
